\item \textit{Notes:} Interval-shift test: the sign strategy with the forecast of bar $c+j$ in place of that of the closing interval $c$, placed on the closing interval's diurnal adjustment, $q_t = \sign\bigl(\hat y_{t,c+j}^{\,2}\, s^2_{t,c} - \mathrm{IV}_t^2\bigr)$, for $j = \rhpsJMin, \dots, \rhpsJMax$ ($j<0$: earlier intervals of day $t$; $j>0$: the first six intervals of day $t+1$). $\SR$ is the paper's Sharpe ratio at mid-quotes (Section~\ref{sec:rh_econ_measures}) on the \rhpsNdays{} post-warmup days on which every shifted forecast exists (the last post-warmup day has no next session), so the $j=0$ column differs from the Sharpe ratios on all \rheSzDays{} post-warmup days; Min and Max run over $j$, $j = 0$ included. Compounding: a fixed $f = \rhappCompF\%$ of wealth per day over the \rhpcNdays{} post-warmup days, terminal value $V$ and maximum drawdown at mid-quotes and at quoted bid/ask prices.
\end{tablenotes}
